from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,stat,datetime
r=Path('/var/tmp/hfs-run-20261030-n17');expected='5ff915e650738e656cd7cc5ad21dad9f2a112083c351601c83c408aa4910afec'
s=r.lstat();assert stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o711
p=r/'plan';s=p.lstat();assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and s.st_nlink==1 and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o600 and p.read_text().strip()==expected
ps=subprocess.run(['ps','-axo','pid,ppid,lstart,command'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout;assert not any('20261030-n17' in line for line in ps.splitlines()),ps
before=subprocess.run(['mount','-p'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout
rows=[line.split() for line in before.splitlines() if len(line.split())>=3 and line.split()[1]==str(r/'m')];assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0][0]=='homelabfs' and rows[0][2]=='fusefs.homelabf',rows
result=subprocess.run(['/sbin/umount',str(r/'m')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
after=subprocess.run(['mount','-p'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout
out={'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'plan_hash':expected,'ownership_verified':True,'no_owned_processes':True,'before_mount':rows,'normal_umount_returncode':result.returncode,'normal_umount_stdout':result.stdout,'normal_umount_stderr':result.stderr,'after_owned_mounts':[line for line in after.splitlines() if '20261030-n17' in line]}
print(json.dumps(out));assert result.returncode==0 and not any(len(line.split())>1 and line.split()[1]==str(r/'m') for line in after.splitlines())
